title: Prenuvo hero
description: A full-window photo hero that pins in place while the next section slides up over it. A big semibold headline with one phrase in seafoam, a soft lead and a gradient pill, centred on phones and set left on desktop, over a darkened backdrop. The copy settles in on load, then fades away and the backdrop drifts up 128px as you begin to scroll.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); sized by the window (100svh)
it is sticky: every block after it needs an opaque background and position relative (the prenuvo blocks have both)
media fills the window like object-fit: cover (a photo or video); empty shows a placeholder
wrap the phrase to highlight in <em> inside the title
the scroll fade and drift follow the page scroll (scroll timeline), so it belongs at the top of the page
name: prenuvo-hero
